verdict.rationale: HubSpot documents a self-serve path: a free CRM with no expiration, and self-service import of companies, deals and activities with associations. It also offers a self-service transfer tool to audit and sync data from an existing CRM, automatic deduplication, and inbox connection, so a founder can plausibly onboard real data without a partner. Nothing in the pack shows pipeline setup or time-to-value, and there is no hands-on account of finishing within an hour. Missing for 10: documented deal-pipeline/stage setup, evidence of the under-an-hour time-to-value, independent or hands-on corroboration of self-serve onboarding without a partner.
